#Goal 
Visualize the relationship between linear distance and number of integrations, for the two launch sites (Nanog_1 and Sox2_-116kb) for which we have many different cargo. 


# Setup
##Libraries
Load the libraries and set the parameters.
```{r load_libraries}

# Load dependencies
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(gtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)

library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(Biostrings)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(ShortRead)
library(GENOVA)
library(GGally)

library(ggbeeswarm)
library(scales)

split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}

```

```{r}
#cutoff to call an integration local
distance_local_hop = 2E6
```

# Load data
All single LP integration data was collected in /home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/CM20260401_collect_mapped_ints_single_LPs.Rmd
Load them here
```{r}
all_ints_comb = read_tsv( "/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/CM20260104_collected_mapped_ints_all.tsv")

all_ints_comb = all_ints_comb %>%
  mutate(type = replace_na(type,'pool')) 

```


## all inserts
Filter for WT genomic background
```{r}
table(all_ints_comb$LP, all_ints_comb$insert, useNA = 'ifany')


all_local_ints = all_ints_comb %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == "pool" & genotype == "WT") %>%
  mutate(hopped = start != LP_coordinate,
         dist_to_LP = case_when(chr == LP_chr ~ start - LP_coordinate,
                                .default = NA),
         local_hop = abs(dist_to_LP) < distance_local_hop & !is.na(dist_to_LP) & hopped) %>% #dont include unhopped ints 
  dplyr::filter(local_hop)

table(all_local_ints$LP, all_local_ints$insert, useNA = 'ifany')

```

There is a contamination with some clones

Mathias dealt with this before for the CTCF paper, get filtered version from him.
filtered version E2401 from CTCF paper
```{r}
tib_E2401_curated_strict = readRDS("/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/E2401_curated_strict.rds") 

tib_E2401_curated_strict_ctrls = tib_E2401_curated_strict %>%
  dplyr::mutate(insert = case_when(insert == "CBS1x_Fw_Sox2P" ~ '1xCTCF_fw_Sox2P',
                                   insert == "CBS3x_Fw_Sox2P" ~ '3xCTCF_fw_Sox2P',
                                   insert == "CBS3x_Rv_Sox2P" ~ '3xCTCF_rv_Sox2P',
                                     .default = insert)) %>% 
  filter(sample_type == "control pool") %>%
  mutate(LP = "-116 kb",
         LP_coordinate = 34643961,
         LP_chr = "chr3",
         genotype = "WT",
         hopped = start != LP_coordinate,
         dist_to_LP = case_when(chr == LP_chr ~ start - LP_coordinate,
                                .default = NA),
         local_hop = abs(dist_to_LP) < distance_local_hop & !is.na(dist_to_LP) & hopped) %>%
  filter(experiment == "E2401")

```

#filtered version dataset
add int he corretly filtered version of E2401
and remove any launch pad contaminations, as we also did in the Science paper.
```{r}
all_local_ints_filt = all_local_ints %>%
  filter(experiment != "E2401") %>%
  bind_rows(filter(tib_E2401_curated_strict_ctrls, local_hop)) %>%
  #standard filtering from the Sox2 paper
    filter(!(start >= 34721183 & start <= 34721192)) %>% #remove contamination from LP8
  filter(! start %in% c(25018987, 35232946) ) %>% #remove contamination clone C1
  filter(landing_pad  == "C9" | start != 34598479) %>% #remove contamination from LP C9
  filter(landing_pad  == "23" | start != 34643961) %>% #remove contamination from LP 23
  filter(landing_pad  == "C10" | start != 35478413)  #remove contamination from LP C10

```

Fraction in regions
```{r }
insert_category_cols_2 <- c(
  "promoter" = "#1B9E77",

  "CTCF" = "#7570B3",
  "CTCF+promoter" = "#E7298A",

)

colscale_insert_cat_2 = scale_color_manual(values = insert_category_cols_2, aesthetics = 'col')
```

## Sox2
For the Sox2 launch site, we plot per biorep
```{r 5D_Sox2_fract_per_region}
plot_fract_Sox2 = filter(all_local_ints_filt, LP %in% c("-116 kb", "-161 kb", "N1")) %>%
  mutate(insert_sample = paste0(insert, "_", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(insert_sample) %>%
  filter(LP == c("-116 kb")) %>%
    filter(insert %in% c('minimal insert', 'Sox2P'))%>%
  mutate(insert_group = case_when(grepl('Sox2P', insert)~ "promoter",
                                  insert == 'minimal insert' ~ 'minimal insert'))%>%
  uncount(read_count) %>%
  mutate(region_ints = case_when(abs(dist_to_LP) < 10E3 ~ "<10kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 100E3 ~ "10kb-100kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 500E3 ~ "100kb-500kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 2E6 ~ "500kb-2Mb",
                                 .default = 'problem'         
                                 )
  )%>%
  mutate(region_ints = factor(region_ints, levels = c("<10kb", "10kb-100kb", "100kb-500kb", "500kb-2Mb")))%>%
  group_by(insert_sample,insert,insert_group, region_ints)%>%
  summarize(N = n())%>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N/sum(N))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = region_ints, y = fract_ints, col = insert_group)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0))+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab('region of integration')+
  ylab('fraction of SB reads') + 
  ggtitle('Sox2 locus, -116kb, per replicate')+  
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  colscale_insert_cat_2

  
filter(all_local_ints_filt, LP %in% c("-116 kb", "-161 kb", "N1")) %>%
  mutate(insert_sample = paste0(insert, "_", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(insert_sample) %>%
  filter(LP == c("-116 kb")) %>%
    filter(insert %in% c('minimal insert', 'Sox2P'))%>%
  mutate(insert_group = case_when(grepl('Sox2P', insert)~ "promoter",
                                  insert == 'minimal insert' ~ 'minimal insert'))%>%
  uncount(read_count) %>%
  mutate(region_ints = case_when(abs(dist_to_LP) < 10E3 ~ "<10kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 100E3 ~ "10kb-100kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 500E3 ~ "100kb-500kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 2E6 ~ "500kb-2Mb",
                                 .default = 'problem'         
                                 )
  )%>%
  mutate(region_ints = factor(region_ints, levels = c("<10kb", "10kb-100kb", "100kb-500kb", "500kb-2Mb")))%>% 
  group_by(insert_sample,insert,insert_group, region_ints)%>%
  summarize(N = n())%>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N/sum(N)) %>%
  filter(region_ints == "<10kb") %>%
  group_by(insert) %>%
  summarise(mean(fract_ints))
```
## Nanog
For the Nanog locus, we plot per unique insert (combining bioreps)

```{r 5F_fraction_in_regions_Nanog}
plot_fract_Nanog = filter(all_local_ints_filt, LP %in% c("-116 kb", "-161 kb", "N1")) %>%
  # mutate(insert_sample = paste0(insert, "_", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(insert) %>%
  filter(LP == c("N1") & ! insert %in% c("NanogS08", "NanogS10", "pMV001")) %>%
  mutate(insert_group = case_when(grepl('Nanog', insert)~ "promoter",
                                  grepl('pLE', insert) ~ "TF reporter",
                                  insert == 'minimal insert' ~ insert)) %>%
  uncount(read_count) %>%
  mutate(region_ints = case_when(abs(dist_to_LP) < 10E3 ~ "<10kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 100E3 ~ "10kb-100kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 500E3 ~ "100kb-500kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 2E6 ~ "500kb-2Mb",
                                 .default = 'problem'
                                 )
  )%>%
  mutate(region_ints = factor(region_ints, levels = c("<10kb", "10kb-100kb", "100kb-500kb", "500kb-2Mb")))%>%
  group_by(insert,insert_group, region_ints)%>%
  summarize(N = n())%>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N/sum(N))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = region_ints, y = fract_ints, col = insert_group)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0))+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab('region of integration')+
  ylab('fraction of SB reads') + 
  ggtitle('Nanog locus, per unique insert')+
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  colscale_insert_cat_2
  

filter(all_local_ints_filt, LP %in% c("-116 kb", "-161 kb", "N1")) %>%
  # mutate(insert_sample = paste0(insert, "_", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(insert) %>%
  filter(LP == c("N1") & ! insert %in% c("NanogS08", "NanogS10", "pMV001")) %>%
  mutate(insert_group = case_when(grepl('Nanog', insert)~ "promoter",
                                  grepl('pLE', insert) ~ "TF reporter",
                                  insert == 'minimal insert' ~ insert,
                                  insert == 'pMV001' ~ 'enhancer')) %>%
  uncount(read_count) %>%
  mutate(region_ints = case_when(abs(dist_to_LP) < 10E3 ~ "<10kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 100E3 ~ "10kb-100kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 500E3 ~ "100kb-500kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 2E6 ~ "500kb-2Mb",
                                 .default = 'problem'
                                 )
  )%>%
  mutate(region_ints = factor(region_ints, levels = c("<10kb", "10kb-100kb", "100kb-500kb", "500kb-2Mb")))%>%
  group_by(insert, insert_group, region_ints)%>%
  summarize(N = n())%>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N/sum(N))%>%
  filter(region_ints == "<10kb") %>%
  group_by(insert) %>%
  summarise(mean(fract_ints))
```

## TF reporter expression

Compare <10kb fraction TF reporters to their expression

```{r S6B_10kb_fraction_TF_reporters, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}
tib_expr_TF = readRDS('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure5_integration_locations_cargo/CM20260415_fluorescence_TF_reporters.rds')

tib_expr_TF_for_join = tib_expr_TF %>%
  filter(clone == '1' & insert != "WT" ) %>%
  mutate(insert_name_join = case_when(insert == "TP53" ~ 'tfr_p53',
                                      .default = paste0("tfr_", tolower(insert))))


promoter_cols <- c(
  "NRF1" = "#1D6F8A",
  "OCT4_SOX2" = "#1C8C8C",
  "STAT3" = "#1B9E77",
  "TP53" = "#4DBB96",
  "random2" = "grey40"
)

tib_for_plot_GFP_local = 
  filter(all_local_ints_filt, LP %in% c("-116 kb", "-161 kb", "N1")) %>%
  mutate(insert_sample = paste0(insert, "_", experiment)) %>%
  group_by(insert_sample) %>%
  filter(LP == c("N1") & ! insert %in% c("NanogS08", "NanogS10", "pMV001")) %>%
  mutate(insert_group = case_when(grepl('Nanog', insert)~ "promoter",
                                  grepl('pLE', insert) ~ "TF reporter",
                                  insert == 'minimal insert' ~ insert,
                                  insert == 'pMV001' ~ 'enhancer')) %>%
  uncount(read_count) %>%
  mutate(region_ints = case_when(abs(dist_to_LP) < 10E3 ~ "<10kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 100E3 ~ "10kb-100kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 500E3 ~ "100kb-500kb",
                                 abs(dist_to_LP) < 2E6 ~ "500kb-2Mb",
                                 .default = 'problem'
  )
  )%>%
  mutate(region_ints = factor(region_ints, levels = c("<10kb", "10kb-100kb", "100kb-500kb", "500kb-2Mb")))%>%
  group_by(insert_sample, insert_group, insert_name, region_ints)%>%
  summarize(N = n())%>%
  mutate(fract_ints = N/sum(N))%>%
  filter(insert_group== "TF reporter") %>%
  mutate(insert_name_join = tolower(insert_name)) %>%
  left_join(tib_expr_TF_for_join) %>%
  
  #for plotting
  filter(region_ints == "<10kb") %>%
  mutate(insert = factor(insert, levels = names(promoter_cols))) #order nicely for legend
  

ggplot(tib_for_plot_GFP_local, aes(x = rel_GFP_cor, y = fract_ints)) +
  #plot data
  geom_point(aes( col = insert)) +
  stat_cor(label.y.npc = 'bottom', method = 'spearman') +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', col = 'black')+
  #layout
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0.05)))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,NA), expand = c(0,0), breaks = pretty_breaks(n=5)) + 
  xlab('relative GFP fluorescence') + 
  ylab('fraction of reads <10kb from launch pad')+
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = promoter_cols) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```
